lines.rom: jaya jaya giridhari prabhu jaya jaya giridhari danava dala balahari go dvija hitakari
jaya govinda dayanidhi govardhana dhari vamsidhara banavari braja jana priyakari
ganika gidha ajamila gajapati bhayahari arata arati hari jaga mangala kari
gopalaka gopesvara draupadi dukhadari sabara suta sukhakari gautama tiya tari
jana prahlada pramodaka narahari tanu dhari jana mana ranjanakari diti suta samhari
tittibha suta samraksaka raksaka manjhari pandu suvana subhakari kaurava mada hari
manmatha manmatha mohana murali rava kari vrndavipina vihari yamuna tata cari
agha baka baki udharaka trnavarta tari bidhi surapati madahari kamsa muktikari
sesa mahesa sarasvati guna gavata hari kala kirati bistari bhakta bhiti hari
narayana saranagata ati agha aghahari pada raja pavanakari cahata citahari
